issues.description: Template placeholder 'url = ""  # CI fills this' found in conanfile.py. Code style Rule 5 explicitly forbids this pattern in merged code, listing it as an unfinished placeholder that should be filled by the adapter.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace the empty url with the actual recipe repository URL, e.g. url = "https://cnb.cool/your-org/ohos-3rdparty-archives/-/tree/main/archives/a/aws-shell/0.2.2" or remove the url attribute entirely if not applicable.

issues.description: Manifest field names deviate from the standard format defined in Rule 14. Uses 'software:' instead of 'name:' and nests build system as 'build.system:' instead of top-level 'build_system:'. The rule specifies: name, version, build_system, status as top-level fields.
issues.fix_suggestion: Rename 'software' to 'name' and either move 'build.system' to top-level 'build_system' or ensure the project schema explicitly documents this alternate format as an accepted variant.

issues.description: patch_description values do not follow the convention shown in Rule 12. The rule example shows patch_description starting with the patch number (e.g., '0001 build aux config.guess'), but the actual descriptions are prose-style without the patch number prefix.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider prefixing patch descriptions with the patch number for consistency, e.g. '0001 Update PKG-INFO metadata format to 2.1 and add Requires-Dist' and '0002 Remove trailing blank line from entry_points.txt'.

issues.description: Output format in test.sh uses [ok] and [fail] markers but does not follow the [step] prefix convention with 8-space indented sub-results as specified in Rule 9. The test script outputs [ok]/[fail] without a preceding [step] line or the 8-space indent alignment.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider wrapping test sections with [step] headers and indenting [ok]/[fail] results with 8 spaces for better structured output, e.g. echo '[step] Checking entry points...' then echo '        [ok] aws-shell found at: ...'.

issues.description: Shebang is '#!/bin/bash' instead of '#!/usr/bin/zsh' as specified in Rule 6. However, this deviation appears justified: the test_package/conanfile.py explicitly invokes bash (via CONFIG_SHELL or /data/service/hnp/bin/bash) for OHOS compatibility, and bash is the standard shell on the target platform.
issues.fix_suggestion: This is an acceptable deviation for OHOS platform compatibility. No change needed unless the project standard is strictly enforced.

summary: Audit passed. P0=0, P1=0, P2=3 (non-blocking), P3=2 (non-blocking). Fixed: rule7_safe_mode false positive removed (test.sh now uses set -euo pipefail).
